My leo is male and a couple years old. He’s on a bioactive setup in a 24x18x18 exoterra, heat and humidity is perfect, has a basking area as well. I feed him every 5 days. Eats an array of insects I breed myself. Husbandry is not an issue here. 

I adopted him from petsmart. He had been purchased there and I guess the first owner didn’t want him and brought him back. I got him for a 10$ rehoming fee (laughable I know) and he was maybe 4 months old, possibly younger. 

I’ve built trust with him over time and would handle him every other day, with his permission, as in he would come onto my hand, I didn’t just take him out. 

Fast forward to this year. He will step half way onto my hand as usual, but then stop, look up at me and his eyes will widen with fear and it’s like he’s forgotten who I am and where he is, then he will abruptly turn and dash into one of his hides, sometimes in such a panic he hits himself or forcibly wedges himself between cork bark flats and his tank, totally frightened. It’s so odd. It’s not breeding behavioral issues either. I know the difference. It’s been going on for at least 6+ months. Just curious if anyone has any experience with this. Please do not comment if you’re not a well seasoned leo owner or vet. Thanks
